fieldValues.title: Pages
fieldValues.summary: Choose the page to edit from the page list in the bar. Each page is a container of blocks; New page starts one.
fieldValues.explanation: A website's pages are the containers anchored on a record of its page type, as its site Composition names it. Choose one in the bar to edit it; **New page** starts an empty page with its own key, which becomes its address on the site once it is published.
fieldValues.ai_guidance: Tell the writer which page they are on, and that a new page needs a key (its address) and must be published in Page settings before the site shows it.
